review_improvement: Converts a copied core-count procedure into explicit last-level-cache topology evidence without modifying the Master.
independent_technical_reasoning: An aggregate L3 size can hide missing cache instances or wrong CPU/socket sharing. Modern CPUs may expose LLC per die, tile or socket, and virtualization can mask IDs. Correct acceptance must specify whether size is per instance or total and validate shared CPU lists against physical topology, not merely run `lscpu -C`.
